Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Sharma
 Order

The present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.c. seeks following prayers:
"Issue a writ in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondent to release the petitioner on parole for a period of four weeks; or b)Pass any other order or further orders, which this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper on the facts and in the interest of justice"

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the parole is sought on the ground that the mother of the petitioner has passed away on 13.02.2023 and the Tehravi is fixed for 24.02.2023 at his native place at Village VPO Bath Asali, PS Nanpur, District Sitamarhi, Bihar.
The aforesaid fact has been verified by the State vide their status report dated 20.02.2023, which has been handed up in Court today and the same has been taken on record.

The nominal roll dated 16.02.2023 reflects that the present petitioner has undergone incarcenation for a period of 7 years, out of 15 years of rigorous imprisonment awarded to him under Section 376 of the IPC.

In view of the aforesaid situation, the petitioner is directed to be released on parole for a period of 10 Satya Narayan Rai vs State Of Nct Of Delhi on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149526902/
1 days, from the date of his release, on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/-, with the concerned Jail Superintendent, further subject to following conditions:
i.

entities.text: Satya Narayan Rai vs State Of Nct Of Delhi
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner shall mark his presence at P.S. Nanpur, District Sitamarhi, Bihar on 25.02.2023, at 02:00 PM and the petitioner shall surrender within a period of 10 days, from the date of his release.
ii. The petitioner shall also provide a mobile number of his relative with whom he will be staying at the designated place to the Investigating Officer.
iii. The said mobile number provided shall be kept in working condition at all times and shall not be switched off or changed without prior intimation to the Investigating Officer concerned.
The writ petition is allowed and disposed of accordingly.
Order be uploaded on the website of this court forthwith.
Copy of this order be sent to the concerned Jail Superintendent in Central Jail No. 1, Tihar, New Delhi, for necessary information and compliance.
